flags.why: Thư tín is formal correspondence vocabulary, so leaving it untagged suggests ordinary conversational usage ([reference](https://tudientiengviet.org/thu-tin-2/)).
Quyền công dân means the rights of a citizen, whereas citizenship can mean the status of being a citizen.

This invents a plundering sense for a word meaning exploitation, including taking excessive profits or unfair advantage ([dictionary](https://medialib.qlgd.edu.vn/Uploads/THU_VIEN/shn/1/1124/UserFiles/Tu-Dien-Tieng-Viet-Hoang-Long-thuviensach.vn-b6c5cba7-6d08-4fa4-aae4-6b53ec52276c.pdf)).
